source_path: Floom original, written 2026-11-01 as a generic version of the private Buffer scheduler Federico De Ponte uses for LinkedIn and X.
note: The method is Federico De Ponte's: drafts by default and arming only the exact approved text, no publish-now path, first comment or X reply per platform, a per-channel daily cap where drafts count as taken, and a queue read that fails loudly instead of looking empty. His accounts, channel names, caps, ref-link tracking and personal posting rules were removed. buffer_posts.py was written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code; it calls only https://api.buffer.com/ with the user's own BUFFER_TOKEN from the environment. Request shapes were checked read-only against the live API on 2026-11-01 (queue read and a dry-run draft; nothing was created). Not affiliated with Buffer.
